items.title: American Express (AXP) Brings AI Payments To Cardholders And Broadens Basketball Perks
items.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) and OpenAI launched AI-driven payments via ChatGPT Wallet, integrating Amex cards directly into the chat interface. The new ChatGPT Wallet feature allows eligible American Express cardholders to initiate and authorize card payments within ChatGPT conversations. American Express broadened its partnership with the NBA, WNBA, and USA Basketball, adding new global experiential and loyalty perks for cardholders. items.title: Is American Express (AXP) Reasonable After A 104% Run And New Card Deals?
items.summary: American Express has delivered strong gains over the past three years, so the real question now is whether the current share price is supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. Over the past 3 years the stock has risen 104.0%, which puts real weight on whether those past returns on capital can justify where the valuation sits today. items.title: JPMorgan’s Top Credit Cards Executive Is Leaving the Bank
items.summary: Allison Beer, the CEO of card and connected commerce, “has informed me of her decision to leave the firm for an external opportunity,” JPMorgan Co-President Troy Rohrbaugh said in a memo on Friday.

items.title: Amex Platinum's $600 hotel credit now comes with a catch starting in 2027
items.summary: American Express has made a few updates to the benefits offered by the Platinum Card®, including changes to its hotel and airport perks.

items.title: Amazon Prime and Uber Eats partnership: $0 delivery fees on $25+ orders for Prime members
items.summary: As of November 5, 2026, Amazon has partnered with Uber Eats to offer Amazon Prime members a new benefit: $0 delivery fees on qualifying orders of $25 or more.
